versions.changelog:
Initial public release of Code Mentor — an interactive AI programming tutor.

- Offers guided learning, code review, debugging, algorithm practice, project mentoring, and design pattern exploration.
- Supports Python and JavaScript.
- Adapts to all experience levels and preferred learning styles.
- Includes 8 specialized teaching modes (concept learning, code review, debugging, algorithm practice, etc.).
- Provides environment setup guidance for learners.
